Claim 26 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; and the NSAID is a propionic acid NSAID, an acetic acid NSAID or a salicylic acid NSAID, wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain and fever is preserved, wherein the non-aqueous carrier does not include a triglyceride oil.

Claim 27 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises from 20 wt.% to 60 wt.% phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 29 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the weight ratio of NSAID to non-aqueous carrier is about 2:1 to about 1:2.

Claim 30 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is a salicylic acid NSAID.

Claim 31 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is salicylate, ibuprofen, ketoprofen, naproxen, oxaprozin, diclofenac, etodolac, indomethacin, ketorolac, aspirin, or combinations thereof.

Claim 32 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is aspirin, salicylate, diclofenac, naproxen, ibuprofen, indomethacin, or combinations thereof.

Claim 33 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is a lecithin, essential oil, vegetable oil, animal oils, vitamin A, vitamin D, vitamin E, fish oil, or mixtures and combinations thereof.

Claim 35 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is lecithin.

Claim 39 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the composition does not include a solvent.

Claim 40 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the composition does not include methanol, ethanol, or chloroform.

Claim 41 (Previously Presented): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and aspirin NSAID, said aspirin NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of aspirin NSAID to biocompatible oil carrier of about 5:1 to about 1:5, wherein the biocompatible oil carrier does not include a triglyceride oil.

Claim 43 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 41 wherein the non-aqueous biocompatible oil is lecithin.

Claim 44 (Previously Presented): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and ibuprofen NSAID, said ibuprofen NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of ibuprofen NSAID to non-aqueous biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, wherein the biocompatible oil carrier does not include a triglyceride oil.

Claim 46 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 44 wherein the biocompatible oil is lecithin.

Claim 47 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and indomethacin NSAID, said indomethacin NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of indomethacin NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, wherein the biocompatible oil carrier does not include a triglyceride oil.

Claim 50 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and salicylate NSAID, said salicylic acid NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of salicylic acid NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, wherein the biocompatible oil carrier does not include a triglyceride oil.

Claim 51 (Currently Amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.
